name: Unit 1 重点词汇
formula:
matter n. 问题，事情
What's the matter? 怎么了？出什么事了？
sore adj. 疼痛的，酸痛的
have a cold 感冒
stomachache n. 胃痛，腹痛
have a stomachache 胃痛
foot n. 脚，足
neck n. 颈，脖子
stomach n. 胃，腹部
throat n. 咽喉，喉咙
fever n. 发烧，发热
lie v. 躺，平躺
lie down 躺下
rest v.&n. 放松，休息
cough n.&v. 咳嗽
explanation:
【词性分类】
名词：matter, sore, stomachache, foot, neck, stomach, throat, fever, cough
形容词：sore
动词：lie, rest, cough

【重点搭配】
- What's the matter? = What's wrong? 怎么了？
- have a cold：感冒
- have a stomachache：胃痛
- lie down：躺下

hit v. （用手或器具）击，打

explanation:

名词：X-ray, toothache, headache, break, passenger, trouble

介词：onto, off

name: Unit 1 词汇（三）
formula:
